val/docs-index.txt\"", "aggregated_output": "- [host-compat](https://docs.mcpjam.com/sdk/reference/host-compat.md): API reference
for @mcpjam/sdk/host-compat; derive server requirements, evaluate host compatibility, and scan widget bridge usage.\n- [List run i
terations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/list-run-iterations.md): Per-iteration results: actual tool calls, stru
ctured token usage, and latency. Cursor-paginated.\n- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api
-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpjam-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev,
CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organization's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api
/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).\n- [Authenticate and record an eval start](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/au
thenticate-and-record-an-eval-start.md): Called by official SDK, CLI and Vitest runners before executing an eval. Requires an orga
nization API key or saved-login bearer. Records only start metadata, creates no dashboard run, and applies no debit or quota draw.
Planned iterations are intent, not completed usage. Reuse the runStartId for ret…\n- [Read the organization's spend budget](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/read-the-organizations-spend-budget.md): The ceiling on what this organization may spend
on MCPJam-billed work (chat, evals, judges and computer time) in the current billing window, and how much of it has been spent.\n-
[List organizations](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/list-organizations.md): The organizations the caller belongs t
o: the source of the `organizationId` that `GET /projects` filters by and `POST /projects` accepts. An API key is bound to one org
anization and only ever sees that one. Read-only: organization, member, role and billing changes are not part of the public API.\n
- [Usage breakdown](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's
sessions used.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-th
e-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and d
raws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a
request here takes one from there.\n- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insi
ghts-for-an-eval-run.md): **No credits are consumed**: the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws o
n the same shared `insightsPerDay` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.\n- [Send one agent Playground message](https
://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/chat-sessions/send-one-agent-playground-message.md): Send one message to a project's MCP servers
and get the model's reply plus the telemetry a participant in the conversation could not see: which tools ran, with what arguments
, what each returned, per-call latency, and token usage.\n- [Read a chat session's execution trace](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-re
ference/chat-sessions/read-a-chat-sessions-execution-trace.md): Per-turn execution spans: per-tool-call latency, token usage, and
indices into the transcript. Same span shape as the eval iteration trace.\n", "exit_code": 0, "status": "completed"}}
